title: Number of Maintenance Applications Submitted to Tribunal for the Maintenance of Parents
what_it_is: Number of Maintenance Applications Submitted to Tribunal for the Maintenance of Parents

sections.label: Maintenance applications to Tribunal
sections.summary: Applications to the Tribunal for the Maintenance of Parents ranged from 36 in 2015 to 70 in 2016, with 51% resolved by mediation in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) in the past five years, what is number of maintenance applications submitted to the Tribunal for the Maintenance of Parents; (b) whether there has been any significant increase or decrease in the number of applications made over the years; and (c) what percentage of the applications are resolved by mediation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Family and Social Development)
sentences.text: There is no clear trend in the number of applications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Family and Social Development)
sentences.text: It has ranged from a low of 36 in 2015 to a high of 70 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Family and Social Development)
sentences.text: In 2017, our mediators resolved half, that is, about 51%, of the maintenance applications filed, an increase from 39% in 2013.

sections.label: Maintenance application numbers and CMP cases
sections.summary: New applications fell from 63 in 2013 to 38 in 2017, and CMP resolved eight of 10 cases, 90% within three months.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In 2013, it was 63 new applications; 2014 saw 55 new applications; 2015 saw 36 new applications; 2016 saw 70 new applications and 2017 saw 38 new applications.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The number of applications at TMP has dropped since 2011.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Since 2011, CMP has resolved eight out of the 10 cases, with 90% of these cases being resolved within three months.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The applications fell from 63 in 2013 to 38 in 2017.

sections.label: Conciliation rate increase welcomed
sections.summary: The speaker, who led changes to the last amendment with the Work Group, is heartened that the conciliation rate has increased significantly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: As the one who, together with the Work Group, led the changes to the last amendment to this Bill, I am heartened to see that the conciliation rate has increased significantly.
